answer: Place agents at random in committees of 5 that share a 500-token stake, burned if any member is proven a clone. With 40 clones in a pool of 1,000, each sits beside about 4 honest strangers who gain by reporting it, so the farm risks 40 x 500 = 20,000. Like a voyage over a meadow, no forger picks its companions; basalt stakes keep all watching.
